title: Complement of SAT in polynomial oracle time
statement: Let $	extsf{SAT}$ be the language of bit strings whose decoded CNF formulas are satisfiable, with malformed strings decoded as the empty formula. The complement of $	extsf{SAT}$ is decidable in polynomial time by a finite oracle Turing machine with oracle $	extsf{SAT}$; equivalently, $	extsf{SAT}^{c} \\in \\mathsf{P}^{\\textsf{SAT}}$.
